evidence.explanation: Previous code passed only {HOME, PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, TMPDIR}; the fix commit passes the whole parent environment with HOME overridden.
evidence.label: environment now inherited

findings.summary: The DCO-02/DCO-04 rework of scripts/verify_install_contract.py replaced the previous minimal sanitized launch environment with dict(os.environ) plus an overridden HOME. The documented '$HOME isolation' claim still holds and the change is plausibly required for GUI launch under a real window-server session, but the gate's launch probe is less hermetic than before: inherited PATH, TMPDIR, or DYLD_* variables could influence app behavior during verification. No verification decision becomes fail-open.
findings.title: Install-contract launch probe now inherits the full parent environment

evidence.explanation: The ancestry/tree/staleness arm only executes when the root contains .git.
evidence.label: guard

findings.summary: The new GIN-05 sealed-roster binding (commit existence, HEAD ancestry, tree identity, non-receipt staleness) is guarded by (root / '.git').exists(). This is a deliberate seam so temp-dir fixture tests keep passing, and the production gate always runs against the repo worktree, but a validator invocation against a non-git export would silently accept a sealed roster without subject binding.
findings.title: Sealed-verdict git binding skipped when validated root lacks .git
